# STAG Industrial to Participate in NAREIT Conference


STAG Industrial, Inc. announced today that it will be participating in NAREIT’s REITworld 2026 Annual Conference the week of November 16, 2026.


[Read More about "STAG Industrial to Participate in NAREIT Conference", Opens in new window, (PDF)](https://www.stagindustrial.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Press-Release-Conference-NOV-2026.pdf)
